paragraphs: Rav Mesharshiya bar Rava (without further specification).

In [Chullin 50a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.50a.14), Rava boasted of him, saying, “My son is expert in the laws of terefot, like Rabbi Yochanan.” Otzar Yisrael cites Kiddushin 33a; Hyman says this is an error.[^2][^1]

notes.text: [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2566&lang=en) pairs the Chullin praise with the Kiddushin reference. Hyman calls the reference in Otzar Yisrael an error. In Chullin, Rava plainly calls Mesharshiya “my son.”

[Kiddushin 33a:14](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.33a.14) names Rav Mesharshiya without a patronymic among sages seated across the river from Abaye. Hyman quotes the terefot praise from the separate Chullin passage.
